cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_kbd_worker C)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
# Root owns later canonical source registration; this fixture builds new sources.
add_library(cui_kbd_worker STATIC "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/base/cui_kbd.c"
 "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/components/cui_kbd.c")
target_link_libraries(cui_kbd_worker PUBLIC cui)
cui_warnings(cui_kbd_worker)
add_executable(test_kbd "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_kbd.c")
target_link_libraries(test_kbd PRIVATE cui_kbd_worker cui_software)
cui_warnings(test_kbd)
add_test(NAME kbd_source COMMAND test_kbd)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/KBD.md")
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/KBD.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" example "${guide}")
if(NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing Kbd guide C example")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kbd_guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(kbd_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kbd_guide.c")
target_link_libraries(kbd_guide PRIVATE cui_kbd_worker)
cui_warnings(kbd_guide)
